Population decreased in North Norfolk

The estimated population of North Norfolk in 2024 was 103,217 usual residents, a fall of 0.1% since 2023.

This meant that North Norfolk was among one of only eleven local authorities in England and Wales where the population got smaller.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of North Norfolk decreased by 0%.

Over this slightly longer period, North Norfolk was also among the 20% slowest growing local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of North Norfolk

The average (median) age rose to 56 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of North Norfolk has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
North Norfolk is an area that is classed as rural in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, North Norfolk's population of 103,217 usual residents was made up of:

  • 13,420 people aged 0 to 15 years, (13%)
  • 53,717 people aged 16 to 64 years, (52%)
  • 36,080 people aged 65 years and over, (35%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, North Norfolk has a higher proportion of people aged 65 years and over (35% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In North Norfolk, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from births and deaths.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in North Norfolk
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for North Norfolk, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More deaths than births led to a fall in the population of 938 people (-0.9%). In total, there were 578 births and 1,516 deaths in North Norfolk.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 600 (0.6%). There were 5,599 people entering the area and 4,999 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in North Norfolk's population of 244 (0.2%) as a result of 448 people entering the area and 204 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for North Norfolk was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of North Norfolk in mid-2023 is 103,280.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 99 people and internal migration estimates were revised downwards by 47 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 52 people.
